steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each field needs a target, each transform a test, and each count must reconcile.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Field with no target
findings.fix: Map the field to a target

findings.title: Count does not reconcile between source and target
findings.fix: Find the missing records before go-live

example:

pros: Checks a field with no target, a transform with no test, and a count that does not reconcile between source and target.
cons: Not checked: Data quality beyond the reconciliation.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-data-migration-check skill on the records for this review.
